name: Hearthglow Tonic
description: Warmth and healing in one gulp. Tastes like a fireside hug.

name: Slumber Syrup
description: Calm, then sleep, then a dream about a very polite owl.

name: Valour Cordial
description: Courage with a cool head, for anything spooky. Side effect: heroic posing.

name: Moonbloom Draught
description: Makes things grow in cold, cursed or night-time places. Turnips may get chatty.
